notes:
Fake backend only; no hardware was attached and no human reviewed or tested the package. G1-G5, G7 and G9 pass; G6 warns NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed used by the next reset and makes no native call) and G8 warns NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.values[*] and seed twice. There are no G4 REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. The fake is a pure Python stand-in for ExtractWorldEnv, not the upstream chemistry: it implements the action interface and a simple mass transfer, the fidelity level is F0, and the driver fidelity gaps disclose the simplifications. NOT COVERED: the full upstream state arrays (three total_num_material x 10 material matrices, total_num_material x total_num_material solute matrices and 100-pixel layer vectors) are replaced by compact three-vessel arrays (4 x 10, 4 x 4 and 5 values per vessel); the real sizes are named in the fidelity gaps, and the tick, reward, termination and reset scalar functions remain available. The cap.world.step.v1 limits are derived at run time by GymnasiumBridge from the fake environment's MultiDiscrete([9, 5]) action space (5 is literal at water_oil_v1.py:56; 9 is the n_actions default at water_oil_v1.py:19, which ExtractWorld_v1 does not override); this package declares no Fact or Limit from a constructor default. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('ExtractWorld_0-v1')) was not run: it needs the upstream package installed plus its legacy gym registration, and the gate never installs or imports the clone.
